description: Documented static pxl image-tag fields and the individually named legacy conv, envt and imp routes. Checks are warnings; account state, delivery and other Trade Desk transports remain outside this profile.

params.name: static_kind
params.description: Exact static tag route extracted from the path.

params.name: adv
params.description: Documented advertiser identifier. Issuance and account ownership remain external.

params.name: ct
params.description: The documented wire value combines the fixed prefix 0, a colon, and an opaque tracking-tag identifier. The Integer table label applies to the prefix, not the complete compound value.

params.name: fmt
params.description: Documented static pixel cookie-sync choice: 3 enables syncing and 4 disables it.

params.name: v
params.description: Optional revenue value uses a period rather than a comma. No amount minimum or maximum is inferred.

params.name: vf
params.description: Optional currency-code string. Reporting uses advertiser currency; no account-currency or closed value constraint is inferred.

params.name: td_values
params.description: Custom values beyond the documented 64-character stored limit receive an advisory, not a receiver-rejection claim.

params.name: gdpr
params.description: Optional destination privacy indicator; core retains its canonical signal validation.

params.name: gdpr_consent
params.description: Optional canonical TC String; core retains structural and applicability checks.

params.name: gpp_consent
params.description: Optional GPP carrier documented for static tags.

params.name: dpop
params.description: Optional comma-separated processing policies. LDU is the only currently documented value.

params.name: dpor
params.description: Optional US region syntax. Geographic eligibility is external.

rules.message: The vendor documents this exact static tag type as deprecated but still in use.

params.name: method
params.description: The published static image tag produces a browser GET.
